verdict.title: Failure of strong quadratic growth in unregularized sparse control of a critical wave equation
exact_checked_claims: On the 3D unit ball with T=1, zero Dirichlet/initial data, real defocusing quintic wave, gamma=beta1=1 and beta2=0, for every fixed sufficiently small positive timewise spatial-L2 cap rho and every finite nu>=0, target pi*e has zero as unique global optimizer, with gap at least ||u||_L1(H)^3/(12*rho^2).
The ordinary critical cone at zero is exactly {0}, so the source substitute strict second-variation condition on nonzero critical directions is vacuous.
Centered pulses h*e on |t-1/2|<h have L2(H)^2 norm 2*h^3 and actual nonlinear cost gap (pi^2/3+2/pi^2)*h^4+O(h^6), proving no positive L2-squared growth in either L2 or L-infinity neighborhoods.
Global optimizers exist for every target d in H and finite nu>=0 in this capped small-input model; every optimizer at target (pi+epsilon)*e has L2(H) norm divided by epsilon tending to infinity.
Local L1(H)-squared growth holds with coefficient 1/(4*pi^2). Arbitrary small target changes give every optimizer L1(H)=O(epsilon), L2(H)=O(sqrt(epsilon)), uniformly in nu.
Along positive radial target changes, every optimizer has L1(H)=Theta(epsilon) and c*epsilon^(3/4)<=L2(H)<=C*epsilon^(1/2), with radial lower-bound neighborhood allowed to depend on fixed nu.
assumptions: Spatial unit ball in R3, time interval [0,1], homogeneous Dirichlet boundary and zero energy initial data.
Real defocusing y^5 nonlinearity, compatible energy/Strichartz mild state.
Positive fixed sufficiently small cap on ||u(t)||_L2(B), not pointwise spatial amplitude. Bochner L1(H)/L2(H) norms.
Sparse/state penalty coefficients one, quadratic control coefficient zero, optional velocity penalty finite and nonnegative.
Positive radial epsilon limit with rho and nu held fixed; stated uniformity distinctions preserved.
